BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.

4. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool
